name.la: Benjamin minor (De praeparatione animi ad contemplationem)

description.la: Benjamin minor, sive De praeparatione animi ad contemplationem: per historiam filiorum Jacob, ordo virtutum et affectuum quibus anima ad contemplationem praeparatur.
description.en-US: Richard’s treatise on the preparation of the soul for contemplation, read through the story of Jacob’s twelve sons, Rachel and the youngest, Benjamin: how reason and affection are ordered by the virtues before the mind is lifted up. 87 chapters. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 196, 1855), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: O tratado de Ricardo sobre a preparação da alma para a contemplação, lido na história dos doze filhos de Jacó, de Raquel e do caçula Benjamim: como a razão e o afeto são ordenados pelas virtudes antes que o espírito se eleve. 87 capítulos.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 196 (Paris 1855); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text RiSVi.BenMin, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
